fullDescription: A quiet, monochrome editorial testimonial section laid out as a numbered vertical quote rail of three large light pull-quotes on warm off-white paper, with hairline dividers, per-row left accent bars that grow on hover, faded opening-quote glyphs, gradient-ink initials avatars and extreme wide-tracked micro-type. No color accent. Inter, Iconify Lucide.
prompt:
## Resumo
A quiet, gallery-grade editorial testimonial section for a prompt-to-UI design product (placeholder brand 'Praxis.studio'), built as a numbered VERTICAL QUOTE RAIL of three large airy pull-quotes rather than a card grid. The ground is a warm off-white paper (#f7f6f3) with near-black ink text (#1c1c1e, plus soft #2c2c2e and muted #48484a) and a faint platinum (#c7c7cc); there is no color accent at all, the whole piece is restrained monochrome. Top-down: a sticky translucent paper nav (an ink 'P' tile + a 'Praxis.studio' wordmark, center muted text links, a 'Sign in' link and a rounded-full solid ink 'Start designing' pill); then the section, opened by a small uppercase mega-tracked 'What people say' eyebrow beside a thin hairline rule and a 36-40px semibold tracking-tight two-line heading; then a quotes rail of three <article> rows, each a 12-col grid pairing a left index block (a big light '01 / 03' number + a 'Verified user' micro-label and a slim left accent bar that grows on hover) with a right column holding a big faded opening-quote glyph, a light ~31px max-w-46ch quote, and a byline (a gradient-ink round initials chip + a thin divider + a name over an uppercase role); hairline dividers separate the rows. It closes on a micro footer line ('Trusted by 4,200+ design teams' opposite a 'Read more voices' arrow link). Inter throughout, a faint dotted grain texture, Iconify Lucide arrow.

## Estilo Visual
Design a quiet editorial testimonial section for a prompt-to-UI SaaS as a NUMBERED VERTICAL QUOTE RAIL of three large pull-quotes, not a card grid. Use Inter (weights 300/400/500/600/700) as the only font. Palette is monochrome with NO accent: paper #f7f6f3 (background), ink #1c1c1e (default text) with ink-soft #2c2c2e + ink-muted #48484a for secondary copy and platinum #c7c7cc as a faint tint. Make the pull-quotes deliberately LIGHT: font-light, text-[24px] -> sm:[28px] -> lg:[31px], leading-[1.34], tracking-[-0.015em], capped at max-w-[46ch]. Index numbers are huge font-light (text-[42px]/sm:[48px]) with tabular-nums (.num-serif font-variant-numeric tabular-nums). ALL micro-text (eyebrow, 'Verified user', roles, footer) is tiny 10-11px, font-medium, UPPERCASE, extremely wide-tracked: define .tracking-mega (0.34em) and .tracking-wide2 (0.18em). Build structure from HAIRLINES, not boxes: a .hairline = linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(28,28,30,.16) 12%, rgba(28,28,30,.16) 88%, transparent) used as a 1px rule between quotes and a 120px max underline on the eyebrow. Each quote row is a group with a slim absolute left ACCENT BAR (w-[3px] rounded-full bg-ink-muted/70 h-12) that on group-hover grows to h-20 and darkens to bg-ink (transition 500ms). Add a faint .grain texture (radial-gradient ink at 2.5% on a 4px grid, opacity .4) over the section. Avatars are small round gradient-ink INITIALS chips (bg-gradient-to-br from ink-soft/ink-muted to ink, text-paper), never photos. Add a custom ::selection of bg-ink/text-paper. Keep it calm, premium, monochrome; no color, no boxes, no shadows; the only motion is the bar growing and the footer arrow nudging on hover.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky translucent paper nav
A sticky top header (sticky top-0 z-50) border-b border-ink/10 bg-paper/85 backdrop-blur-md. Inside a mx-auto flex max-w-[1180px] items-center justify-between px-6/sm:8/lg:10 h-[68px]: LEFT = a logo lockup group: a flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-[7px] bg-ink text-paper text-[13px] font-semibold 'P' tile + a text-[15px] font-semibold tracking-tight wordmark 'Praxis' followed by a text-ink-muted font-light '.studio'. CENTER = a nav hidden md:flex items-center gap-9 text-[13.5px] text-ink-muted with links 'Library', 'Canvas', 'Voices' (active, text-ink font-medium), 'Pricing', each hover:text-ink. RIGHT (flex items-center gap-3) = a hidden-sm:inline-block 'Sign in' text link (text-[13.5px] text-ink-muted hover:text-ink) + a rounded-full bg-ink px-4 py-2 text-[13px] font-medium text-paper hover:bg-ink-soft 'Start designing' pill.

### Section eyebrow + heading
Open a section#voices relative .grain overflow-hidden, content in mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6/sm:8/lg:10. At pt-24/sm:28/lg:32: an eyebrow row = a flex items-center gap-4 with a text-[11px] font-medium uppercase .tracking-mega (0.34em) text-ink-muted 'What people say' + an h-px flex-1 max-w-[120px] .hairline rule. Then a heading h2 mt-6 max-w-2xl text-[30px]/sm:[36px]/lg:[40px] font-semibold leading-[1.08] tracking-[-0.02em] reading 'Designers who stopped' <br hidden sm:block> 'fighting the blank canvas.'.

### Numbered quote rail + row anatomy
A quotes rail div mt-16/sm:20/lg:24 pb-24/sm:28/lg:32 space-y-0 of three <article> rows, each separated by a full-width div h-px .hairline. Each row = a group relative grid grid-cols-1 -> lg:grid-cols-12 gap-y-7/lg:gap-x-12 py-12/lg:py-16 pl-6/sm:pl-7 with an absolute left-0 top-12/lg:top-16 h-12 w-[3px] rounded-full bg-ink-muted/70 ACCENT BAR that transition-all duration-500 group-hover:h-20 group-hover:bg-ink. LEFT lg:col-span-3: an index block = a flex items-baseline gap-2 .num-serif with a text-[42px]/sm:[48px] font-light leading-none tracking-tight text-ink number ('01','02','03') + a text-[12px] font-light text-ink-muted '/ 03', then a mt-3 text-[10px] font-medium uppercase .tracking-wide2 text-ink-muted 'Verified user'. RIGHT lg:col-span-9: a .bigquote block text-ink/20 select-none mb-7 aria-hidden opening-quote glyph (font-size 56px, line-height 0), then a p max-w-[46ch] text-[24px]/sm:[28px]/lg:[31px] font-light leading-[1.34] tracking-[-0.015em] text-ink QUOTE, then a byline mt-9 flex items-center gap-5 = an inline-flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br (from ink-soft/ink-muted/ink) text-[13px] font-medium text-paper INITIALS chip + an h-9 w-px bg-ink/15 divider + a block (a text-[14.5px] font-semibold leading-tight text-ink NAME over a mt-1 text-[10.5px] font-medium uppercase .tracking-wide2 text-ink-muted ROLE). Use placeholder reviewers like 'Sarah Chen / Design Director · Linear', 'Marco Oliveira / Founding Engineer · Cadence', 'Aïsha Diallo / Product Designer · Slate Labs' and calm, product-true quotes (attention to detail, shipped an onboarding flow before lunch, reads my intent not just my words).

### Footer micro-line
After the last .hairline divider, a footer row pt-10 flex flex-col -> sm:flex-row items-start/sm:items-center justify-between gap-4: LEFT a text-[10.5px] font-medium uppercase .tracking-mega text-ink-muted 'Trusted by 4,200+ design teams'; RIGHT a group inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-[13px] font-medium text-ink-muted hover:text-ink link 'Read more voices' + an Iconify lucide:arrow-right (data-width 15) that group-hover:translate-x-0.5.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Numbered vertical quote RAIL: three full-width <article> rows ('01/03', '02/03', '03/03') separated by hairline dividers, rather than a card grid

### Componente
Hairline divider system: a .hairline = a 1px horizontal gradient rule that fades to transparent at both ends, used between every quote and as a short underline on the eyebrow

### Componente
Slim left ACCENT BAR per row: a 3px rounded ink-muted bar at the start of each row that grows from h-12 to h-20 and darkens to full ink on group-hover (500ms)

### Componente
Big faded opening-quote glyph (.bigquote, 56px, line-height 0, text-ink/20) introducing each pull-quote

### Componente
Deliberately LIGHT large quotes: font-light 24-31px, leading-[1.34], tracking-[-0.015em], capped at max-w-[46ch] for an editorial measure

### Componente
Huge light index numbers with tabular-nums (.num-serif) paired with a 'Verified user' micro-label

### Componente
Round gradient-ink INITIALS avatar chips (bg-gradient-to-br ink-soft/ink-muted -> ink, text-paper) with a thin vertical divider before the byline, never photos

### Componente
Extremely wide-tracked micro-typography: .tracking-mega (0.34em) and .tracking-wide2 (0.18em) on the eyebrow, 'Verified user', roles and the footer line

### Componente
Faint dotted .grain texture (2.5%-opacity ink dots on a 4px grid) over the whole section for a paper feel

### Componente
Custom ink ::selection (bg-ink, text-paper) and a 'Read more voices' footer link whose arrow nudges right on hover

### Componente
Fully monochrome system: NO color accent anywhere, hierarchy is carried entirely by type weight, size, tracking and hairlines

## Notas Especiais
Single font via Google Fonts: Inter (weights 300/400/500/600/700), set as fontFamily.sans ['Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif]. Styled with Tailwind via CDN using a custom theme: colors ink { DEFAULT #1c1c1e, soft #2c2c2e, muted #48484a }, paper #f7f6f3, platinum #c7c7cc; body class font-sans text-ink antialiased with body background #f7f6f3. Custom CSS: html scroll-behavior smooth + -webkit-font-smoothing antialiased + text-rendering optimizeLegibility; .tracking-mega letter-spacing 0.34em; .tracking-wide2 letter-spacing 0.18em; .hairline background linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(28,28,30,0.16) 12%, rgba(28,28,30,0.16) 88%, transparent); .quote-fade transition opacity/transform .6s; .num-serif font-variant-numeric tabular-nums + font-feature-settings 'tnum'; .bigquote font-size 56px line-height 0; ::selection background #1c1c1e color #f7f6f3; and a .grain::before (absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none opacity .4) with background-image radial-gradient(rgba(28,28,30,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px) at background-size 4px 4px. Icons are the Iconify runtime (code.iconify.design) rendering one Lucide icon: lucide:arrow-right in the footer link. There is no JS beyond the Iconify/Tailwind CDNs; nav links and the footer link are static anchors and the only interactions are CSS hovers (the left bar grows/darkens, the arrow nudges). The signature moves are the numbered vertical quote rail, the fully monochrome no-accent palette, the hairline gradient dividers, the per-row left accent bar that grows on hover, the big faded opening-quote glyphs, the deliberately light large quotes on a 46ch measure, and the extreme wide-tracked micro-typography. Keep it strictly monochrome (never add a hue), keep structure as hairlines not boxes, keep quotes light and airy, keep avatars gradient-ink initials (never photos).
